# [1.7.3-beta.9] - 11.06.2026

## 🔍 Pre-stable review batch (#485)

A full 7-angle review of everything since v1.7.2 surfaced 23 verified findings — two of them blockers in this release's headline features. All fixed (by @traktore-org in [#486](https://github.com/traktore-org/sem-community/pull/486)):

- **Rolling-horizon scheduler no longer ratchets the charge target** — re-plans anchored the target on the live SOC and stacked the deficit on top of charging progress, grid-charging toward 95% every profitable night; the target is now anchored on the SOC at the window's first evaluation, and a mid-charge NOT_NEEDED/NOT_PROFITABLE re-evaluation stops the active charge
- **`set_option` on construction-time keys reloads again** — `tariff_mode` / `battery_*` scheduler params persisted but never took effect until restart (the #462 silent-no-op class)
- Re-plan trigger fires once per price update (was 2 INFO lines per 10 s from price publish until window open); 15-min markets get the slot length from the provider; `battery_cycle_cost` runtime default back to 0.0; Nord Pool fetch backoff; charger-merge order preserved; atomic mixed set_option payloads; dual-tariff auto sign vote; late-loading split-grid sensors adopted; stale actuation Repairs cleared; canonical primary-charger id; price-parse memoization + split-grid scan throttle — see CHANGELOG for the full list

## 🔌 Wallbox actuation: entity-range bounds + working stop path (#487)

- **Current writes are bounded into the target entity's own min/max** — HA core rejects out-of-range number writes BEFORE anything reaches the charger: 0 A stops were structurally impossible (entity min 6 A) and >entity-max ramps bounced. The real "keeps charging in off mode" mechanism (by @traktore-org in [#490](https://github.com/traktore-org/sem-community/pull/490))
- **0 A stop intents route through the pause-switch / stop_session path** instead of the doomed number write
- **`ev_start_stop_entity` is now actually honored** as the Wallbox pause/resume switch
- **Health-check violation WARNINGs rate-limited** (was one line per 10 s cycle)

## 🧭 Grid-sign restart hardening

- **Sign votes are ignored for the first ~2 min after startup** — a restart locked the wrong grid sign on a Huawei install from votes cast while the recorder replayed counter states (observed live on PROD); the sign-lock log now names the voting counter entities

## 🖼️ Diagram card blank on Home tab (#488)

- **Backticks inside a lit-template comment terminated the template literal** — valid JS that threw at render time, blanking the system diagram; fixed + lint guard (by @traktore-org in [#489](https://github.com/traktore-org/sem-community/pull/489))

## 🧪 Tests

- 3505 tests pass (≈75 new across the review batch, Wallbox bounds, sign warmup, template lint)
